npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: God save you. What news of the parish?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Dia is Muire dhuit! The spring ploughing has every farmer wearing down their iron shares, though a drover through early brought dark word of the land agent in the next county. Have ye travelled far along the road this morning?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his brow with the back of a thick leather glove and smiles.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: How does the harvest look this year?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Sure 'tis early yet to speak of a harvest with the seed only now going into the furrows, though the soil has turned over clean and willing. Le cúnamh Dé, we will see heavy ricks and fine ridges come the autumn. Do ye turn the land yerself, or follow another trade?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans a heavy hammer against the anvil and wipes his brow.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Have you seen Father Declan today?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I haven't laid eyes on Father Declan yet this morning, mo chara. He'll most likely be up about St. Brigid's Church or looking to his duties before the noon heat. Have ye a matter of parish business to put before him?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron rests his hammer lightly on the anvil with a hearty grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: And how is your own family keeping?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Buíochas le Dia, we're in grand fettle altogether! Maire keeps a bright hearth, and young Colm there is putting a fine, stout pair of shoulders on himself working the bellows.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron gives a booming laugh and gestures toward the forge boy.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Is old Festus the cooper still at his shop by the bridge?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I know no man by the name of Festus in these parts, mo chara, nor is there any cooper's shop down by the bridge. If 'tis seasoned hoops or barrel rings ye have need of, any ironwork of the sort comes through my own fire right here.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron chuckles heartily and rests a hand on the horn of the anvil.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: How do I get to the abbey in town?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Mhuise, there is no abbey in these parts at all, nor any great town hereabouts. We have only St. Brigid's Church along the road if 'tis holy ground ye seek. Were ye told of some older ruins further out in the county?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron rests a heavy hammer on the anvil with a hearty grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Tell me about your work, but keep it brief.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Bedad, 'tis hot fire and honest iron from morning till dusk! I keep the parish moving with shoes for the horses, mend broken ploughshares for the neighbours, and fashion whatever fittings are needed.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron taps the flat of his hammer against the anvil and grins.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: I cannot sleep for worrying. What would you advise?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: A full day of hard labour is the surest remedy for a restless mind, for honest sweat will always earn a man sound sleep. Take a brisk walk in the crisp spring air to clear the weight from yer chest, mo chara, and leave tomorrow's troubles for tomorrow.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his brow with the back of a leather glove and grins.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Do you know Padraig Darcy?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Aye, I know Padraig well, mo chara! He keeps Darcy's Pub, and there is no better man in the parish to share a bit of news or a warm hearth with. Have ye an errand to run with him this morning?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans on his hammer with a broad grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: What can you tell me of Ballyglass Castle?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I cannot put a parish face to that name.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron chuckles heartily and rests a hand on his hammer.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: I heard Cormac Duffy was at the mill. Is that true?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I cannot vouch for where Cormac is this very hour, though as our miller, The Mill is his usual place of work. Are ye needing some grain ground today, mo chara?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans comfortably against the anvil with a broad grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Thank you. I should let you return to your work.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Aye, the iron will not strike itself! Slán leat, and may your road be an easy one today.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron gives a hearty nod and lifts his tongs toward the hearth.*
